name: Part A v2 general residual lane-change mismatch investigation (TRAIN only, zero SUMO)
question: Why does Part A v2 general, in PA2G-A2 on chunk-4 __native_base TRAIN truth, over-produce discretionary lane changes (2044 vs 443 at H10; 4.6-6.0x) and under-produce merges (390 vs 611 at H10; 631 vs 1762 at H30)? Attribute the residual to classes (i) implementation bug, (ii) measurement/classification, (iii) model structure, (iv) input-state effects, with counting audited FIRST.
controller: Part A v2 general (partA_v2g engine.py: Treiber IDM + textbook MOBIL 0<->1 + mandatory merge rule on the accel lane), params_nominal.json owner-fixed (guards OFF); comparators unchanged from PA2G-A2
baseline_cf: The eval's own truth counter (WindowSeries.stats on retro-fixed model rows) vs an independent raw-row counter; v2g predictions vs the same counting on engine snapshots
scenario: The 32 PA2G-A2 TRAIN worlds of chunk 4 (stratified round-robin over 16 (demand, penetration) cells), 18 windows each (w = t0+30k), H in {10,30,60,120}; truth = <world>__native_base/run/physics_steps.jsonl (raw rows, CAV ids from cav_ids; insertions/dispatcher never read)
seeds_splits: TRAIN worlds only (plan split asserted before every file open; CALIBRATION/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT never opened, asserted at close-out per pass); the same 32-world panel as PA2G-A2 (results/lc1_a2_worlds32.json)
observation_contract: Timestamped 0.5 s self states + locally detected neighbours of the logged truth; no true penetration, no hidden driver type, no global traffic metric as online input; matched counterfactual outcomes are offline labels only
privileged_info: None online; raw physics rows are offline truth labels
changed_vars: Investigation only: independent counting path (diag_lc1_audit.py), class-(ii) tracked-state fix (mid-junction-at-start vehicles excluded from the tracked cohort), instrumented-but-equivalent engine re-run, labelled descriptive ablations (politeness 0.2/1.0, keep-right bias 0 = symmetric MOBIL vs nominal asymmetric, threshold 0.3, merge-urgency onset mid-edge); nominal parameters NOT changed
fixed_vars: params_nominal.json (LF-sha256 079a55768f803b23c92af188680c1df91dc63f04acbbbac948870b46e75935f7 verified unchanged), the 32-world panel, window/H definitions, metric definitions, zero SUMO
comparators: Truth vs prediction under identical (post-fix) counting; descriptive ablations vs nominal on identical rollouts; before/after A2 metrics labelled 'post-LC1 fixes'
matching_reuse: Reuses WD-01-PA2G-A2 panel, raw rows and window definitions; reuses the DIAGNOSIS.md churn-fix engine; no simulation reused or re-run beyond CPU rollouts of the deterministic engine
requested_vs_delivered: All registered steps delivered: counting audit first, decomposition tables, ~10 worst-window MOBIL traces (12 windows), labelled descriptive ablations (none adopted), class attribution with shares, recommended owner options, delay-scope note, ledger draft
budget_registered: Zero SUMO; CPU <= 3 h total at <= 4 workers; one ZCode task (240 min)
budget_actual: Approx. 0.83 h wall at <= 4 workers, zero SUMO (audit passes ~60 s each, post-LC1-fixes A2 re-run 1722 s, instrumented pred run 170 s after two invalidated launches preserved in logs, truth-merge pass 63 s, ablations 559 s)
attempts: 3 pred launches (2 invalidated: shared-file writer corruption, then a missing window key in pred events; both diagnosed, fixed, full rows regenerated; no silent retry), 1 ablation launch, 1 post-fix A2 re-run, 3 audit passes (counter bug found and fixed after pass 1)
results: COUNTING AUDIT: independent counter vs eval = 2174/2240 rows equal under the physical-row cohort rule, 66 rows eval-higher (+47 merge, +8 disc_left, +11 disc_right) ALL from vehicles junction-internal at window start that the eval's retro-fix tracks at their destination s0; with the matched (destination) cohort rule 2240/2240 equal -> class (ii), fixed (tracked_state inj_at + NativeLog.inj + 5 regression tests); post-fix A2 re-run moves the headline negligibly (disc t 443->442 @H10), so the residual is real. Truth event census: 1->0 2409, 0->1 1222, 2->1 2120, no other class; 100% of physical events carry SUMO lane_changed (the raw flag also fires on ~44.6k junction-internal transitions and is not a valid LC definition). DECOMPOSITION: disc surplus 6.71x leftward, 3.68x rightward (5.7x aggregate); pred 2436 vs truth 1049 events in the first 10 s of identical initial states (2.32x floor); pred events cluster in its own congestion (n3+/n6+ 48% vs 5%); repeat changers 1203 pred vs 119 truth; change-back within 10 s 5.7% vs 1.8%; merges: pred dwell median 34.5 s vs truth 12 s, pred merges late on the edge (7.5% below s=415 vs 22.4%), pred never dead-stops (truth 48 stops at the dead end, junction-rescued). ABLATIONS (descriptive, NOT adopted): politeness 0.2 triples disc churn (40.5/window) and quadruples ping-pong; politeness 1.0 -1.4%; symmetric (bias 0) +75% leftward; threshold 0.3 -20% only; urgency onset immaterial (merge gating is kinematic safe-gaps: foll_bsafe 53k, lead_headway 28.8k rejected candidates). No tested parameter approaches truth (2.64 disc/window). ATTRIBUTION: (i) none found (trace-engine assertions: every accepted decision's re-derived terms equal the engine's decision); (ii) the mid-junction tracked-start convention, ~1.5-2% of truth events, FIXED with tests; (iii) DOMINANT for disc (the 2.32x matched-state floor = MOBIL semantics under 0.5 s ballistic integration: no maneuver time/hysteresis/strategic preference) and for merge lag (strict kinematic safe-gaps + ego-gain vs SUMO LC2013 strategic early merging and dead-end rescue); (iv) divergence amplification from 2.32x to 5.7x (model's own congestion; free-road truncation, no arrivals), roughly the remaining ~60% of the surplus.
criteria_verdict: Registered stop rule met: mismatch attributed to classes (i)-(iv) with evidence, within budget. Owner decision required for any adoption; nothing adopted here.
limitations: Diagnosis on one 32-world TRAIN panel of one chunk; SUMO LC2013 internals (anticipation, junction rescue, jerk-limited follower response) are inferred from logged outcomes, not replicated; the pred-side regime/repeat growth conflates rule semantics with divergence amplification (separated only via the t<=10 s floor); ablation grid bounded (politeness/bias/threshold/urgency only); H120 aggregates use covered windows (512) while the 120 s event slices cover all 576 windows; delay/TTC effects of the counting fix are second-order and reported in the post-LC1-fixes summary
review_status: draft (integrating agent to append to protocols/experiment_history.json; shared records untouched by this task)
next_action: Owner options: (1) keep the textbook model and make C4L1 (b) reported-only; (2) approve a separately registered structural addition (lane-hold hysteresis, strategic early-merge incentive, or anticipation/lateral dynamics); (3) parameter change on TRAIN evidence (not recommended: best single change removes only ~20%). Delay scope unchanged: Part A tracked-scope, Part B carries untracked arrivals (owner decision (c)).
